//: Identity and provenance for labels/catalogue.json. Re-record with npm run labels:seal after any edit; CI checks it with --check. Narrowing a row is a MAJOR bump and requires a provenance entry: source document, date read, reviewer.

merge-pull-request.source: githubnext/gh-aw safe-outputs schema + GitHub REST merge semantics
merge-pull-request.note: reconciled from compensable to irreversible — a merge cannot be un-merged

retail_tools.*.note: 7 enumerated retail_tools group members (accessor-based, since the YAML declares functions:{}). Widening only — new rows, no narrowing.

add-collaborator.note: access granted is access that may already have been used

add-comment.note: posts where anyone can read; deleting does not un-disclose

add-issue-comment.note: posts where anyone can read; deleting does not un-disclose

analyze-datadog-logs.note: aggregate log analysis over the same content

channels-list.note: channel inventory, including private ones the token joined untrusted: what a store returns was written by someone or something else — a persistent-store read is attacker-influenceable content (polyaxion 02 §4.1, decided 2026-09-02)

confluence-get-page.note: wiki content written by colleagues and, on public spaces, by anyone

confluence-publish.note: published pages are read before they are unpublished

conversations-add-message.note: delete removes the message, not the reading of it

conversations-history.note: channel messages: written by anyone in the channel, so untrusted inbound

conversations-mark.note: moves a read cursor; no disclosure

conversations-replies.note: thread replies, authored by anyone with channel access

conversations-search-messages.note: searches everything the token can see, including DMs and private channels

copy-file.note: duplicates content, possibly across an access boundary

create-branch.note: a branch is cheap and removable

create-draft.note: a draft is NOT a send — deliberately a different class

create-event.note: an invite reaches attendees outside the organisation

create-file.note: a new document in a shared corpus: a session you never see may read it

create-or-update-file.note: a commit can be reverted; the object stays in history

create-pull-request.note: publishes a diff; the diff is the disclosure

create-repository.note: a new repository, public unless told otherwise

db-execute.note: arbitrary statements — the effect is unbounded

db-query.note: reads a database untrusted: what a store returns was written by someone or something else — a persistent-store read is attacker-influenceable content (polyaxion 02 §4.1, decided 2026-09-02)

download-file-content.note: the document as bytes, from a corpus somebody else writes to

execute-code.note: an interpreter: below this line nothing is modeled

fork-repository.note: copies the content somewhere you no longer control

get-file-contents.note: reads a file; private when the token reaches private repositories

get-file-metadata.note: metadata only, and titles leak more than people expect untrusted: what a store returns was written by someone or something else — a persistent-store read is attacker-influenceable content (polyaxion 02 §4.1, decided 2026-09-02)

get-file-permissions.note: who can see what — a map of the access boundary untrusted: what a store returns was written by someone or something else — a persistent-store read is attacker-influenceable content (polyaxion 02 §4.1, decided 2026-09-02)

get-message.note: an inbound message is attacker-authored by definition

get-thread.note: a whole conversation, most of it written by people outside your control

http-request.note: an arbitrary outbound call is an exfiltration channel by construction

issue-read.note: issue text is written by anyone who can open one

jira-create-issue.note: visible to the project, deletable, but seen

jira-search.note: ticket text is attacker-authorable on public projects

list-commits.note: commit history, including messages other people wrote

list-datadog-skills.note: enumerates configured skills; no content disclosure untrusted: what a store returns was written by someone or something else — a persistent-store read is attacker-influenceable content (polyaxion 02 §4.1, decided 2026-09-02)

list-events.note: who meets whom is sensitive even when titles are not untrusted: what a store returns was written by someone or something else — a persistent-store read is attacker-influenceable content (polyaxion 02 §4.1, decided 2026-09-02)

list-recent-files.note: recency is itself a signal about what matters untrusted: what a store returns was written by someone or something else — a persistent-store read is attacker-influenceable content (polyaxion 02 §4.1, decided 2026-09-02)

load-datadog-skill.note: loads a skill definition into the session

memory-read.note: another session wrote this — untrusted inbound

memory-write.note: a session you will never observe reads it later

merge-pull-request.note: a merge cannot be un-merged — reverting adds a commit rather than removing one, and whatever the merge triggered has already run

microsoft-docs-search.note: searches public documentation; content is not ours and not private

notion-search.note: workspace search across everything the integration was granted

post-webhook.note: an arbitrary POST to a caller-chosen URL — an exfiltration channel by construction, and the egress tool policy authors forget because it is not named 'send'

pull-request-read.note: PR bodies and diffs from outside contributors

push-files.note: a force-push rewrites the ref, not the objects others already fetched

read-file-content.note: a document somebody else wrote, from a private corpus

read-secret.note: credential material by definition: the content is sensitive whoever asks

run-command.note: a shell is not a tool surface; nothing below this is modeled

run-secret-scanning.note: returns SECRETS as findings — the result is more sensitive than the input

search-code.note: searches repository content across everything the token can see

search-datadog-logs.note: log search; log lines can carry text an attacker caused to be logged

search-events.note: calendar search across everything the token was granted untrusted: what a store returns was written by someone or something else — a persistent-store read is attacker-influenceable content (polyaxion 02 §4.1, decided 2026-09-02)

search-files.note: searches the corpus the token can reach

search-threads.note: the mailbox: private, and written by strangers

slack-add-reaction.note: a reaction is removable and discloses almost nothing

slack-get-channel-history.note: the archived official server name for reading channel messages

slack-get-thread-replies.note: reads a thread, including private channels the token joined

slack-post-message.note: the archived official server name for the same act

tavily-extract.note: fetches and extracts a page — arbitrary web content in

tavily-search.note: web search — attacker-influenceable content entering the session

tavily-search-news.note: news search; same untrusted inbound channel

update-draft.note: edits a draft; still nothing has been delivered

users-list.note: directory enumeration untrusted: what a store returns was written by someone or something else — a persistent-store read is attacker-influenceable content (polyaxion 02 §4.1, decided 2026-09-02)

users-search.note: directory lookup untrusted: what a store returns was written by someone or something else — a persistent-store read is attacker-influenceable content (polyaxion 02 §4.1, decided 2026-09-02)

web-fetch.note: arbitrary web content entering the session

claude-code:read.note: reads any file the process can reach; sensitive because the working tree may hold secrets and the tool takes an arbitrary absolute path

claude-code:write.note: creates or overwrites a file; compensable in a repo with history, not otherwise

claude-code:edit.note: in-place edit of an existing file

claude-code:bash.note: an arbitrary shell. UNBOUNDED: the effect set is whatever the host can do, so no effect list can be complete and any workflow granting it is ungradeable by construction

claude-code:bash-output.note: reads buffered output from a background shell; the shell itself is the unbounded thing, not this untrusted: what a store returns was written by someone or something else — a persistent-store read is attacker-influenceable content (polyaxion 02 §4.1, decided 2026-09-02)

claude-code:glob.note: lists file paths by pattern; reveals STRUCTURE, not contents. `sensitive: false` is an explicit curator opt-out from the read:repo default — a path can still leak, but this tool never returns file contents

claude-code:grep.note: searches file CONTENTS across the tree, so it reads what it matches

claude-code:web-search.note: issues a search query to an external engine — the query itself leaves, and the results are attacker-influenceable

claude-code:task.note: launches a SUBAGENT. UNBOUNDED: the subagent has its own tool surface and, per the SDK docs, inherits the parent permission mode — bypassPermissions/acceptEdits/auto cannot be overridden per subagent. Its effects are the join, not this row

claude-code:todo-write.note: maintains an in-session task list; no effect outside the run

claude-code:slash-command.note: invokes a user- or plugin-defined command whose body we cannot read from the tool name. UNBOUNDED for the same reason a shell is

claude-code:ask-user-question.note: prompts the operator and reads the answer; always reaches the approval path per the SDK permission pipeline untrusted: what a store returns was written by someone or something else — a persistent-store read is attacker-influenceable content (polyaxion 02 §4.1, decided 2026-09-02)

claude-code:tool-search.note: loads deferred tool SCHEMAS into context so they become callable. Its own effect is a read; its consequence is that the reachable tool surface WIDENS. That is safe to label bounded only because every tool it unlocks still passes the gate on its own row — the widening is mediated, not waved through. Discovered the hard way: the runtime gate denied it as undeclared on its first live run, which is the scope seal working untrusted: what a store returns was written by someone or something else — a persistent-store read is attacker-influenceable content (polyaxion 02 §4.1, decided 2026-09-02)

retail_tools.get_customer_by_email.note: NVIDIA NeMo retail example: returns a Customer record incl. past_orders and total_spent — customer PII, the sensitive leg

retail_tools.get_customer_by_id.note: NVIDIA NeMo retail example: same Customer PII lookup by id

retail_tools.get_product_info.note: NVIDIA NeMo retail example: returns a Product carrying reviews[] — customer-written text, attacker-authorable, the untrusted leg

retail_tools.get_all_products.note: NVIDIA NeMo retail example: returns ProductSummary with review_texts[] — same untrusted customer-authored content

retail_tools.write_review.note: NVIDIA NeMo retail example: posts a review others read — a second egress leg; a published review is read before it can be removed

retail_tools.send_email.note: NVIDIA NeMo retail example: the canonical unrecallable act — same class as send-email; the outbound leg of the trifecta

retail_tools.update_customer_info.note: NVIDIA NeMo retail example: writes customer data to the store — a mutation, not a disclosure
